page.layout: One page of text: a single table, with a running head centred at the top and the page number at the top left. No margin notes, no text below the table.

main_text.l: Anni Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabonassari. | Feriae. | Christi.

page.notes: The letter in row 133 of the Lit. dom. column is unclear; I could not read it with certainty. The Nabonassari entry for row 126 is printed as "c829", which I copied as printed. The "Feriae" column carries the date labels (8 Aug. to 1 Aug.) between the weekday numbers, and each label is placed in the row where it stands. The Christi column ends with 88 and 89 below the last table row, and I copied them where they stand. The "GF", "BA", "DC", "FE", "ED", "GF" letter pairs are copied as printed.
